atoms.sound: ssml: Do you know what connectives are?<break time='1500ms'/>
ssml: Connectives are joining words. They can connect two words or phrases to make a longer phrase.

instruction.text: Select the 'and' symbol to learn two of the most common connectives.
instruction.sound: ssml: Select the, and, symbol, to learn two of the most common connectives.

atoms.sound: ssml: We use the word, and, to connect two sentences which follow each other, or to add more information to a sentence. <break time='1500ms'/>
ssml: We use the word, but, to connect two sentences which don’t follow each other or which oppose each other.

instruction.text: Select the two connectives in this picture.

example.a: In summer it is hot. In summer it is sunny.
example.sound: ssml: In summer it is hot.. In summer it is sunny.. <break time='500ms'/> We can connect these sentences.

example.a:
In summer it is hot and sunny.

→ In this sentence, 'and' is the connective.
example.sound: ssml: In summer it is hot, and, sunny <break time='500ms'/>. In this sentence,<break time='500ms'/> and, <break time='500ms'/> is the connective. It connects the words hot and sunny.

example.a: It is cold. I want to wear my new shorts.
example.sound: ssml: It is cold. I want to wear my new shorts. <break time='500ms'/> We can connect these sentences.

example.a:
It is cold but I want to wear my new shorts.

In this sentence, 'but' is the connective. It connects the two phrases.
example.sound: ssml: It is cold, but, I want to wear my new shorts <break time='500ms'/>. In this sentence,<break time='500ms'/> but, <break time='500ms'/> is the connective. It connects the two phrases.

hint.text: Remember: connectives join together other words or phrases. And and but are connectives.
hint.sound: ssml: Remember: connectives join together other words or phrases. and, and but, are connectives.

trainers.finishSound: ssml: ,and, is the connective in this sentence

atoms.sound: The trees are tall and green.

hint.text: Remember: connectives join together other words or phrases. And and but are connectives.
hint.sound: ssml: Remember: connectives join together other words or phrases. and, and but, are connectives.

trainers.finishSound: ssml: ,but, is the connective in this sentence

atoms.b: It is sunny, ((but)) there is still some snow on the ground.
atoms.sound: It is sunny, but there is still some snow on the ground.
